Crashes, emergencies, and insurance", "learner_facing": true, "markdown": "## C — Crashes, emergencies, and insurance

FACT_ID: sec12-F01 | anchor: A01
A driver in a crash must stop at once and stay at the scene [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec12-F02 | anchor: A01
Leaving the scene can bring license suspension or revocation for up to one year [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec12-F03 | anchor: A01
Leaving the scene can also bring jail for up to one year or a fine of up to $2500 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec12-F04 | anchor: A01
An involved driver must give reasonable aid and arrange transport for the hurt when needed [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec12-F05 | anchor: A01
A driver must call law enforcement at once when there is injury, death, or at least $2500 in damage [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec12-F06 | anchor: A01
Drivers must swap name, address, registration number, and insurance contact details [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec12-F07 | anchor: A02
Most crashes cluster between 2 pm and 6 pm, and driver error factors into 75% of crashes [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec12-F08 | anchor: A02
With dead brakes, ease on the parking brake slowly and be ready to release it in a skid [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec12-F09 | anchor: A03
With ABS, push the pedal down hard and hold it while vibration and clicking remain normal [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec12-F10 | anchor: A03
A disabled vehicle needs flashers, a raised hood, a bright marker, and flares set 200 to 300 feet back [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec12-F11 | anchor: A04
Driving without required security is a class B misdemeanor tied to license and registration loss [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-F12 | anchor: A04
An unpaid crash judgment suspends driving privilege after 60 days until paid with SR22 future proof [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-F13 | anchor: A04
Required future proof is normally kept for three years after suspension, revocation, or reinstatement [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0078]

FACT_ID: sec12-F14 | anchor: A05
Liability and PIP or no-fault coverages are mandatory while collision and comprehensive are lien-holder driven [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0079]

Misconceptions: leaving is minor; moving the badly hurt helps; ABS means pump the pedal.
Mnemonics: STOP-AID-REPORT-INSURE for crash steps.
Glossary: liability; PIP or no-fault; collision; comprehensive; SR22; unsatisfied judgment.
